units.source_text: 冷泉帝想向王命妇探问详情。

en.t: Emperor Reizei wanted to ask Omyobu for the details.

units.source_text: 然而他又不愿教王命妇知道母后严守秘密之事已经被他得悉。

en.t: Yet he did not want Omyobu to know that he had already learned the secret his mother had guarded so strictly.

units.source_text: 他只想设法将此事隐约告知源氏内大臣，问他古来有否此种前例。

en.t: He only wished to find some way to hint at the matter to Genji, the Minister of the Center, and ask whether there had been any such precedent in the past.
But in the end no suitable opportunity presented itself.

units.source_text: 于是他更加勤修学问，浏览种种书籍。

en.t: So he applied himself even more diligently to study and read through all sorts of books.

units.source_text: 他在书中发现：帝王血统混乱之事，在中国实例甚多，有公开者，有秘密者；

en.t: In those books he discovered that in China there were many cases of confusion in imperial bloodlines, some public and some secret.
But in Japan there was no precedent recorded in history.

units.source_text: 即使亦有实例，但如此秘密，怎能见之史传？

en.t: Even if such cases had existed, how could a matter so secret appear in the historical records?
Naturally it would never have been passed down to later generations.

units.source_text: 他只在史传中发现：皇子降为臣籍，身任纳言或大臣之后，又恢复为亲王，并即帝位者，则其例甚多。

en.t: What he did find in the histories were many examples of imperial princes who were demoted to subject status, served as counselors or ministers, were later restored as princes, and then ascended the throne.

units.source_text: 于是他想援用此种前例，以源氏内大臣贤能为理由，让位与他。

en.t: He therefore considered invoking such precedents and yielding the throne to Genji, the Minister of the Center, on the grounds of his wisdom and ability.
Thus he turned the matter over in many ways.
